final: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT healtheval, scancount, CASE WHEN spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 AND gbsize IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(gbsize AS REAL) / spanmin ELSE NULL END as gb_per_min FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry), group_stats AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) as total_scancount, AVG(gb_per_min) as rate FROM scan_rates GROUP BY healtheval), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM group_stats) SELECT group_stats.healtheval, group_stats.total_scancount, group_stats.rate, group_stats.rate - avg_rate.avg_rate as rate_minus_avg FROM group_stats, avg_rate WHERE group_stats.rate > avg_rate.avg_rate ORDER BY group_stats.healtheval
